fact: The OSS says Mauritania has institutionalised the GMES services MISLAND-Mauritanie (land degradation monitoring) and SAQIYA-Mauritanie (irrigation management app), both hosted on national servers, with ministries including Agriculture sharing their experience of using the services at the CUCT workshop.

Copernicus Sentinel Online reports a pilot by InsightEx with the National Employment Agency (TECHGHIL) in which the TechghilAgro app and admin dashboard give near-real-time Sentinel-2 vegetation and irrigation indicators for rice farms in Rosso and R'kiz, with a second season planned for October 2025.
Copernicus Sentinel Online says the TechghilAgro pilot reached 102 rice farmers (21 in Rosso, 81 in R'kiz) over 612 hectares in its first season, with 737 app interactions.
